decisions.reason: As a new safety shoe line with several models, it reflects meaningful development and production investment in the firm’s core business, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than withdraw it quickly.

A comfort insole is less central and easier to discontinue than a full footwear line, but as a complementary product to the core shoe business management can still justify keeping it on the market while results remain uncertain.

The supportive insole is a relatively small add-on product, yet it fits the firm’s tailored-solution positioning and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely without clear evidence of failure.

The ergonomic safety shoe series received its own webpage and consists of several models, indicating strong public commitment and strategic importance, which makes management very likely to persist with it.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a more specialized line, but they still build on the firm’s protective-footwear capabilities and the multi-model launch suggests enough commitment to keep supporting them.

Being shown on the home page signals visible commitment to this moulded insole, and management is likely to give it more time as part of its broader footwear-and-fit offering rather than drop it quickly.
